subject: I get Segmentation fault when generating samples from normal distribution

messages.author: b43184f1b55021fb
messages.subject: I get Segmentation fault when generating samples from normal distribution
parts:
I want to generate normal samples with Stan. First I used this code:

import pystan
model = """
data{
    real dmx;
    real dvx;
}
model{
}
generated quantities {
    real rt[50];
    for (i in 1:50){
        rt[i]<-normal_rng(dmx,dvx);
    }
}
"""
sm = pystan.StanModel(model_code=model)
fit=sm.sampling(data={'dmx':0,'dvx':1},
        iter=1,chains=1,warmup=0,seed=1)

And I get:
RuntimeError: Must use algorithm="Fixed_param" for model that has no parameters.

Ok. So now I add the option
fit=sm.sampling(data={'dmx':0,'dvx':1},
        iter=1,chains=1,warmup=0,seed=1,algorithm='Fixed_param')
and I get
Segmentation fault

Looks like a bug to me.

I'm on Pystan 2.6.3, 32-bit Linux.
